exposure: endometriosis (especially severe deep infiltrating pelvis or ovarian endometriosis)
past history of pre-pregnancy surgical management of endometriosis
cohort: The study included 25 pregnant women diagnosed with endometriosis (cases) and 25 pregnant women without endometriosis (controls).
finding: Severe deep infiltrating pelvis or ovarian endometriosis and a past history of pre-pregnancy surgical management of endometriosis were identified as risk factors for maternal complications such as placenta previa, as well as fetal and perinatal complications.
mod_finding: Significant differences were found between the endometriosis and control groups regarding placenta previa and blood loss during both vaginal delivery and caesarean section.
